text:
Type: black box picture frame with mat
Use: framing photos, posters or art prints for a wall, a shelf or a desk; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: black painted frame with a deep flat profile, white mat, clear front panel, back stand
Colors: black, white mat
Shape: rectangular frame with deep box sides and a broad white mat around the picture, stands upright or hangs, crisp and graphic
Feel: graphic, crisp, orderly, modern
Goes with: gallery walls, white walls, black and white photos, light or dark wood; minimalist or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: RIBBA
